newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria forex demand small as market awaits budget.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria forex demand small as market awaits budget.

text.p: Nigeria's central bank said on Friday it sold $76,224 in foreign exchange at a rate of 80 naira to the dollar at its first weekly auction of 1997.
This is in sharp contrast to an average weekly demand of about $20 million last year.
Bankers said the drop was because only two of the 76 banks invited to bid for forex did so.
"Others didn't bother because they are being cautious as they await budget 1997," one said.

Nigeria's military rulers were expected to hold the last budget meeting in the capital Abuja later on Friday and if approved the document could be broadcast this weekend by military ruler General Sani Abacha.
